news.title: As Michigan forges forward on literacy, many ask: What about math?
news.summary_en: In a state laser focused on literacy, educators and leaders say more attention needs to be paid to math.
news.author: Isabel Lohman

news.title: As enrollments plummet, Michigan communities sweat job losses from universities
news.summary_en: For communities around many of Michigan’s public universities, declining enrollments and inadequate state funding may have severe adverse economic impacts.
news.author: Shaina Sternhell, Capital News Service

news.title: Look up how many students miss class in your Michigan school
news.summary_en: Statewide, more than 1 in 4 Michigan K-12 students are missing more than 10% of the school year. The rate is down slightly from the previous year but ‘more work remains,’ according to the state superintendent.
news.author: Isabel Lohman

news.title: Michigan absenteeism inches down; 1 in 4 still miss too much school
news.summary_en: The state’s chronic absenteeism rates have decreased for the fourth year in a row, but more than a fourth of students are missing 10% or more of the school year.
news.author: Isabel Lohman
